Keiki × Maritime

Build an AI product. Reach your first 1,000 users in six weeks.

Keiki × Maritime is a competition for individual builders and teams. Build something useful for everyday life, or an agent for a problem you know from your work.

The first three qualifying projects can earn a three-day San Francisco trip. Sponsored flights are limited to travel within the US.
